notes: Design fidelity holds. Surfaces are near-black, there is one #1ed760 accent, buttons are uppercase pills and type is compact. Typecheck and lint pass. Commit fb3336f fixes several earlier findings. Fixed: tours get the fan/euro scale only when the tour's region is 'Greenroom app' (inApp), so agent-booked tours keep SOL on cards and stats; status lines and attention lines are now built in fans and keep the behind-pace and target-reached wording; the show page's buy button and ticket table use the page's scale; feed lines for app tours speak in fans and euros; the dashboard's empty feed text no longer says 'nothing happened' once tickets have sold; an invalid ?address= says 'This link does not point to a show'; the band's own show card shows msg; the phone nav wraps instead of hiding pages; the phone sweep now connects, so phone-band/feed/tour-new are real connected pages. Partly fixed: resume now books a new tour when the old deadlines are under 15 min away, but it does so silently, leaves the old half-tour's shows orphaned (the dashboard reads only the latest tour), and a re-plan with other venues still adds extra shows; the partial marker can be discarded but is never checked against chain; the show page renames Deadline/Show date but still has no demo-clock note; 'You hold 1 ticket (0.0002 SOL)' stays in SOL. The fix introduces new bugs, some visible in the fresh screenshots. phone-booked-dashboard.png reads 'sales close in 20735d' and 'show in 20735d': the 1 s tick counts up from 0 before chainTime arrives, which defeats timeLeft's !now guard. On short pages (phone-feed.png, phone-approvals.png) about 200 px of empty space opens between the nav and the content, because the min-height:100vh grid stretches both auto rows. describe() in chain-live now always speaks in fans and euros, so agent-booked tours (0.005 SOL tickets) get feed lines like '€10,000 went back to fans' and ×20 fan counts beside cards in tickets and SOL. Chain-read tours never become 'at risk', because fetchLiveTour sets no salesOpenAt. Still open: the /feed page's unconditional 'nothing else has happened' (phone-feed.png, beside 320 fans); 'Ticket purchases (0)' as a bare header beside 'Fans 80 / 400'; no reason when a wallet that already holds a ticket cannot buy again; the crank is still only in the fan's card; show-page state is not reset when the address changes; only the latest tour is searched; the wizard's '€20 = 0.0002 SOL'; the unused slot order; the stacked doc comments; the font is not shipped; phone-venues.png is 10,508 px tall; there is no shot of the fan buy flow.
issues: packages/web/src/app/page.tsx:87 and app/show/page.tsx:69: setNow((n) => n + 1) counts up from 0 before chainTime resolves, so timeLeft's !now guard passes and the cards read 'sales close in 20735d' / 'show in 20735d' (phone-booked-dashboard.png). On the dashboard, chainTime runs only after fetchLiveTour and fetchShows, so this lasts for seconds on a busy devnet. Fix: setNow((n) => (n ? n + 1 : 0)), or seed now from Date.now()/1000 at mount and correct it from chainTime

packages/web/src/app/globals.css:1091-1093: on phones the .shell grid keeps min-height:100vh with two auto rows, so short pages stretch the sidebar row and leave about 200 px of empty space under the nav (phone-feed.png, phone-approvals.png). Fix: add grid-template-rows: auto 1fr (or align-content: start) to .shell in the max-width:896px block

packages/web/src/lib/chain-live.ts:112-126 with components/Feed.tsx:82: describe() always uses fans() and euros(), but fetchShowEvents also serves live tours with inApp=false (agent and --band-keypair tours, ?band= views). Those tours are priced at 0.005 SOL (orchestrator.ts:134), so the feed says '€10,000 went back to fans' and multiplies ticket counts by 20, while the cards beside it show tickets and SOL. 'you €X' in ShowSettled is also wrong for ?band= viewers. Fix: pass an inFans flag through Feed into fetchShowEvents/decode, key the seen cache on (sig, units), and keep the ticket/SOL texts for non-app tours

packages/web/src/lib/chain-live.ts:76-93 with lib/health.ts:65-68: fetchLiveTour sets no salesOpenAt, so opened is undefined, behind is always false, and a chain-read tour (the band's own) never shows 'at risk', never adds an attention line, and the 'At risk' stat is always 0. Fix: for app tours set salesOpenAt = thresholdDeadline - SALES_MINUTES*60 (or the ShowAccepted block time) in fetchLiveTour

packages/web/src/lib/book.ts:171-176: the stale-resume fallback calls bookTour as a new tour silently. The old half-tour's shows stay on chain (venues still sign them and fans can buy), but the dashboard, /feed and the show-page lookup read only the newest tour, so those shows become invisible and their show pages lose city and units. show.all also runs twice on public devnet. Fix: onStatus/notice 'Your unfinished tour expired; booking a new one', list the abandoned shows (or skip proposing when none were signed), and reuse the first show.all result

packages/web/src/lib/book.ts:177-185: if the re-plan picks venues that differ from the existing shows, no stop matches, base stays now+SALES_MINUTES, and the tour gains more shows than planned on a second clock. Fix: refuse to resume unless every existing show's venue is in p.plan; otherwise offer 'Start a new tour'

packages/web/src/app/feed/page.tsx:76: the empty text 'Your shows are booked; nothing else has happened yet' is still unconditional on /feed, and phone-feed.png shows it for a tour with 320 fans and a confirmed show. Fix: use the same sold>0 'Reading the story so far from devnet…' text as page.tsx:407 (pass the tour's ticketsSold)

packages/web/src/lib/health.ts:75-76: inFans wording reads '120 fans more and it goes ahead' and 'Behind pace: 120 fans more needed' (7-booked-dashboard.png, 8-own-show.png). In recordings, 'Goes ahead with 12; still selling' drops 'sold'. Fix: format as `${fans(need)} more fans` / `${n} more` and 'Goes ahead with 12 sold'

packages/web/src/app/show/page.tsx:239: in live (inApp) mode the holding line still says 'You hold 1 ticket (0.0002 SOL)' under a page priced 'Ticket €20' and a button 'Buy 1 for €400'. Fix: 'You hold tickets for 20 fans (€400)' when live
packages/web/src/app/show/page.tsx:236-246: a wallet that already holds a Ticket PDA gets no buy control and no reason. Fix: add 'One purchase per wallet per show' under the holding line

packages/web/src/app/show/page.tsx:280-305 and :55: 'Ticket purchases (0)' renders a bare header row beside 'Fans 80 / 400' (8-own-show.png), and a refused getProgramAccounts in fetchTicketsForShow fails the whole reload. Fix: catch the ticket fetch separately and add an empty row ('Ticket list not readable from public devnet right now' / 'No purchases yet')

packages/web/src/app/show/page.tsx:259-266: the 'check the result now' crank still sits only in the fan's card, so a band cannot settle its own show when the keeper is down. Fix: render it below both cards

packages/web/src/app/show/page.tsx:28-32,82-99: run, others, venueName and live are never reset when address changes. live is only ever set to true, so after client-side navigation from an app show, a recorded or agent show keeps fans/euros. Fix: reset these at the top of the effect and call setLive(!!(me && live?.inApp))

packages/web/src/app/show/page.tsx:87: only the band's latest tour is searched, so shows from an earlier tour (now including the tours the resume fallback abandons) get an h1 of 'Show' and SOL units. Fix: fetch the tour from acct.tour (fetch that Tour account plus its shows) instead of the latest one

packages/web/src/app/show/page.tsx:181-188: 'Sales close in 29m 51s' and 'Show in 59m 51s' sit beside 'Day 1 · Nov 3' without the demo-clock and 1-ticket-=-20-fans note the dashboard has (page.tsx:291-296). Fix: add the same one-line note when live

packages/web/src/app/tour/new/page.tsx:263-264: 'one ticket per 20 people, at €20 = 0.0002 SOL' still says that an on-chain ticket costs €20, while the dashboard counts the same 0.0002 SOL ticket as 20 fans and €400. Fix: 'each on-chain ticket stands for 20 fans and costs 0.0002 SOL of play money (€20 per fan)'

packages/web/src/app/tour/new/page.tsx:36-47: the saved partial-booking marker is still never checked against chain (toursCreated-1 === saved.tourId and the tour still lacks shows), so a marker left by a booking that later finished elsewhere keeps offering 'Finish booking'. Fix: verify it on load and clear it when stale

packages/web/src/lib/chain-live.ts:100: inApp relies on a free-text region string. Tours booked by the wizard before fb3336f ('Central EU') now render in SOL with micro amounts, and any agent brief using 'Greenroom app' would be read as euro-scale. Fix: also check the price scale (ticketPriceLamports <= 200*LAMPORTS_PER_EURO), or treat both as app tours

packages/web/src/lib/chain-live.ts:205,219,237-238: the per-signature slot order is still computed and never used. Same-second events from different transactions sort by decode id (newest-first), so they come out reversed. Fix: sort by (blockTime, slot) using the slot from getSignaturesForAddress
packages/web/src/app/venues/page.tsx:196: phone-venues.png is still 10,508 px tall. Fix: collapse the city cards or default the phone list to one country
packages/web/src/lib/format.ts:40-41: two stacked doc comments on dayLabel; the first belongs to demoDate

packages/web/src/app/globals.css:22: SpotifyMixUI and CircularSp are not shipped, so every page renders in Helvetica or Arial. Fix: load a close open font (e.g. Figtree via next/font) as the first fallback

qa/src/ui-bot.ts:410-445: there is still no fixture with TicketBought/ShowConfirmed logs and no shot of a fan buying or refunding on /show, so the live feed and the wallet buy and refund flows are never seen in screenshots. Fix: add one fake signature with program logs and shoot /show as a connected fan wallet
